data.html_content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Home | Recipes | About

These fluffy, buttery blueberry scones are quick to make and bursting with fresh berry flavor. Serve them warm with clotted cream or your favorite jam.

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 20 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes

Servings: 8 scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 6 tbsp cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1/2 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.

note.content:
# 2025 Q1 OKRs - Archived

## Objectives and Key Results (OKRs)

### Objective 1: Enhance Research Publication Output
- **KR 1.1:** Publish 3 peer-reviewed papers in top-tier journals (e.g., Nature, Science).
- **KR 1.2:** Achieve a 20% increase in citation count for previous publications.
- **KR 1.3:** Submit patent applications for 2 novel computational methods.

### Objective 2: Strengthen Team Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing
- **KR 2.1:** Conduct 12 cross-team workshops with 90%+ attendance.
- **KR 2.2:** Implement a new internal knowledge base with at least 50 documented best practices.
- **KR 2.3:** Increase team satisfaction scores by 15% in quarterly surveys.

### Objective 3: Drive Platform Performance Improvements
- **KR 3.1:** Reduce system latency by 30% for core analytical services.
- **KR 3.2:** Achieve 99.9% uptime for all critical infrastructure.
- **KR 3.3:** Migrate 80% of legacy data pipelines to modern cloud-native architecture.

## Key Points (Summary)
- **Progress:** All objectives were fully or partially met. Objective 1 exceeded targets with 4 papers published.
- **Challenges:** KR 3.3 faced delays due to dependency conflicts; migration completed at 70% by quarter-end.
- **Highlights:** Team collaboration (Objective 2) scored highest, with satisfaction up 18%.
- **Next Steps:** Carry forward unfinished KR 3.3 into Q2, with adjusted timeline and resources.

Blueberry Scones

A delightful, buttery scone recipe with fresh blueberries.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold
  • 3/4 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
  2. Mix dry ingredients in a large bowl.
  3. Cut cold butter into small pieces and mix into dry ingredients until crumbly.
  4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  5. Combine wet and dry ingredients, fold in blueberries gently.
  6. Shape into a circle on a baking sheet, cut into wedges.
  7. Bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.

Enjoy warm with clotted cream or jam!

data.html_content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Home | Recipes | About

These fluffy, buttery blueberry scones are quick to make and bursting with fresh berry flavor. Serve them warm with clotted cream or your favorite jam.

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 20 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes

Servings: 8 scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 6 tbsp cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1/2 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough onto a floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the baking sheet and bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  9. Cool slightly before serving.

Tips & Notes
